office_does: The treasurer receives all money due Spokane County and pays it out on warrants issued by the county auditor.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Treasurer Mike Volz (Prefers Republican Party), appointed and elected in 2025, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County Treasurer since 2025 and a state representative since 2017; a CPA and Army veteran. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed, then elected, treasurer in 2025 after serving as chief deputy treasurer [S1]
Licensed CPA and Army veteran; 6th District state representative since 2017 [S1]
Promoted senior and disabled-persons property-tax relief in a 2025 op-ed with Assessor Tom Konis [S2]
